description: An unknown argument makes the result unknown, of the type the result has
notes: The README and the package documentation don't say whether parameters accept unknown values. hashicorp/hcl declares them without AllowUnknown (decodeUserFunctions in ext/userfunc/decode.go), so by the spec's call rules the result is an unknown value of the result type, which go-cty's Function.Call returns without calling the implementation. That type comes from the function's type callback, which evaluates the result expression with the unknown arguments (spec.Type in decodeUserFunctions).
